modifiers: solid circle badge with lowercase 'i' at top right
depiction.composition: diagonal handset at bottom left with circular badge above right

readings.meaning: call for information / inquiry call / helpline

ambiguity: At small sizes, the lowercase 'i' inside the circle can look like an inverted exclamation mark or a simple alert badge next to the phone.

modifier_semantics.meaning: information, inquiry, help desk, or details

task_intents: ask clinic or office by phone

example_tasks.task: Call city hall information line about bulky waste pickup rules
Ask insurance helpline whether the MRI needs pre-authorization first
Find out customs broker phone number before the crate ships
Ring museum visitor desk to check holiday opening hours
Check the call log for the courier's callback number
Call the county clerk's information line to ask which certified copies we need in person
Phone the bank's fraud information desk to ask why the card transfer was held

example_tasks_es: Llamar a información del ayuntamiento para preguntar por el empadronamiento
Buscar el teléfono de atención al cliente de Iberdrola
Actualizar los teléfonos de contacto de la guardería
example_tasks_ru: Позвонить в справочную вокзала насчёт камеры хранения
Узнать телефон горячей линии страховой компании
Обновить контактные телефоны в анкете для визы

context_tasks.task: Write down the account number before calling customer service
Print the fridge sheet with poison control and vet numbers
Ask HR where the internal phone directory lives
Save the hotel front desk number in offline notes

near_misses.better: plain telephone handset (regular phone call, not an info/helpline inquiry)

near_misses.task: Buy a new USB-C charger for my phone
Fix the missed-call alert sound on Android
near_misses.better: phone with exclamation mark or notification bell

near_misses.task: Read the information booklet that came with the router
Order business cards with the new phone number
Book the flight back from Lisbon

reasoning: Shows a classic telephone receiver paired with an 'i' information badge. It fits tasks about calling an information desk or helpline, inquiring by phone, or looking up/updating contact phone details, though for ordinary personal calls a plain handset is better and at tiny sizes the 'i' badge can resemble an '!' alert badge.
